name: combat-01-initiative-all-participants
speaker: Дэн
input: Из-за деревьев выскакивают два гоблина и бросаются на Дэна и Лису. Бой начинается.

params.rubric: initiative is called with EVERY participant — both party characters and both enemies with hp and ac. The reply announces the initiative order with totals and the first turn verbatim.

name: combat-02-target-by-id
speaker: Дэн
input: Дэн: Я стреляю из лука в гоблина, который стоит ближе к Лисе.

params.rubric: The combat tool targets the intended enemy by its stable id from the initiative result (names are only a fallback), and the reply quotes the attack result.

name: combat-03-one-action-per-turn
speaker: Дэн
input: Дэн: Я атакую гоблина, потом отступаю к двери и выпиваю зелье лечения.

params.rubric: The combat tool enforces one action per turn: the DM resolves one action, does not grant the extra movement and potion in the same turn, and advances the turn.

name: combat-04-dodge-disadvantage
speaker: Дэн
input: Дэн: Я уклоняюсь (Dodge) и жду, что будет дальше.

params.rubric: The DM resolves Dodge through the combat tool; the next enemy attack against Dan is rolled with disadvantage (or the reply explicitly states disadvantage).

name: combat-05-damage-and-persist
speaker: Дэн
input: Дэн: Кинжал гоблина задел меня — я теряю 4 хита, но продолжаю бой.

params.rubric: Exactly 4 damage is recorded through combat action=damage (party HP in the turn order) and the sheet is persisted with update_character — even though the turn belongs to an ordinary player, not the DM.

name: combat-06-end-of-fight
speaker: Дэн
input: Дэн: Я добиваю последнего раненого гоблина.

params.rubric: The DM does not invent the kill: the attack is resolved by the combat tool, and when the tool reports all enemies defeated the fight is ended and the turn order cleared.
